svg.text: Every colour in Rayl sits on one hue: all ten existing values measure between 109.5 and 115.6. The greys and the green are the same colour at different intensities.
They are also unevenly spread — six values crowd between L* 82 and 95, then nothing until L* 54. That hole is where borders, disabled states and secondary fills live.
ROLES — NOTHING PICKS A HEX AGAIN
SEMANTICS — THE FIRST HUE BREAK IN THE BRAND
Drawn at the green's exact lightness and chroma so they join the family. Surface for backgrounds, ink for text on it.
NEW HUE — furthest from the brand
Worth deciding deliberately: this palette may be better served by one semantic hue than four. Error is unavoidable — nothing made of a
yellow-green can mean stop. Success you already have. Warning and info may be doing work a grey chip and a clear sentence would do better.
